label: AI use for building and organising itineraries
question: Do travellers use AI to build itineraries?
answer: 43% of AI users build and organise itineraries with it; 42% use it to research itineraries.
methodology: Sojern paired surveys, April 2026. The traveller and DMO figures were fielded concurrently and published together, but they are two questionnaires: 1,006 US adults on one side, 103 destination leaders worldwide on the other.
